basic_profile.bio: I'm a stay-at-home dad living in Austin, Texas, with my wife and two kids. I have a strong interest in sustainable living and parenting, which is why I'm active in the cloth diapering community. In my free time, I enjoy listening to industrial music and tinkering with SwiftUI for hobby projects. I tend to be online in the late evenings after the kids are asleep, usually from 9 PM to midnight. I used to work in tech as a software developer before deciding to focus on family life. I'm also a fan of the local live music scene and enjoy attending shows when I get the chance.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science and worked for several years as a software developer, which gave me a solid foundation in technology and programming. I've learned a lot about parenting and sustainable practices through hands-on experience and community engagement, such as participating in cloth diapering groups and forums.
